preconditions.description: The number of stations is greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100000.
The total number of commuters is greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100000.
The total units of Nitro is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 10000000.
The distance between each pair of consecutive stations is greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100.
The arrival time of each commuter is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 10000000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= si < ei <= n for all i
preconditions.description: Each commuter's boarding station is greater than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to the destination station.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the minimum sum of travelling time for all commuters.
